doc: RichText renders a small subset of HTML which shall look mostly native in the current view context. A relative link of the own origin navigates within the application, an external link opens in a new tab.

1.doc: Value contains the text, which shall be shown or edited.
1.name: Value

3.doc: ExternalLinkConfirmation is the question, which the user has to confirm before an external link is opened. The full address follows the question. If empty, an external link opens without asking.
3.name: ExternalLinkConfirmation
